data.cultural_impact: In Islamic society, the name Waqid could be given to a person who is highly dedicated and committed to his work or responsibilities, staying up late to complete important tasks or to ensure that his community's needs are met. This name signifies admiration for those who are steadfast in their pursuits, setting an example for perseverance and dedication.
data.spiritual_significance: Waqid holds deeper spiritual meaning for Muslims as it can be seen as a reminder of the importance of staying spiritually focused and awake throughout one's life, especially during the late hours of the night when distractions are at their peak. The concept of "Qiyyamul Layl," the night prayer, holds great significance within Islam, encouraging believers to engage in acts of worship and connecting with Allah during this time, increasing their probability of gaining paradise in the Hereafter. Thus, Waqid, as a name, instills a sense of devotion, mindfulness, and a deeper connection with the divine.
